object.description: Through reorder_outline, send a document's outline back unchanged, then send it with the sub-object made a second top-level object. In the library, swap two objects, nest one under the other, nest three objects three levels deep, and give an empty document an empty outline. Expected: reorder_outline returns ok naming the manifest, and the outline read back is the one sent; each library outline is the one given; after the swap and the nesting, validation reports no error.
